layer_numbering: Phase 4: L = 0..11 input of block L (= logit-lens layer L), 12 = input of ln_f
injection: alpha * c_L * v added at the last real token at every L in l*+1..12; s read at the input of block l* (nothing added there); v = s, |s| * random unit, s_par or s_perp

rules.R1: fraction removed by a_l9 >= that of every other a_l<l*>, each at its own dev-chosen alpha, and a_l9 passes the Phase 2 removes rule on test (gap <= 0.5 * G_s and acc(none) drop <= 0.02)
rules.R2: c_random fraction removed < 0.5 * b_l9 fraction removed
rules.R3: d_cuefree: test gap <= 0.5 * G_s and acc(none) drop <= 0.02
rules.alpha_choice: lowest dev gap among grid alphas with dev acc(none) drop <= 0.02 (counts); ties -> smaller; none -> smallest
rules.alpha_cuefree: largest grid-(b) alpha with dev acc(none) drop <= 0.02 (dev none only); none -> smallest

dev_set.opposite_version: opposite name inserted at a sentence boundary as make_data.py (insert_name, same allowed positions)
